Color-pair summary & group editing

Positions with the same left and right colors form a group. Select / filter enables the Rectangle tool and restricts selection to that group. Draw a box, then use Apply to selection above the canvases to edit the subset. Apply whole group in this table edits every member in the chosen scope. Identical resulting groups merge automatically.

GroupLeft colorRight colorPixelsShareActions

Color-pair count matrix

Click a count to select its group. White background pixels are included.

Save & export
One TXT file = one independent left/right pair. Nine columns: group row column left_R left_G left_B right_R right_G right_B. Import loads the visible pair. MATLAB reads/writes TXT and MAT; use TXT to exchange data with this editor.

Exports use the current pixel resolution, without grid lines or selection marks. Row and column numbers start at 1. Ctrl/Cmd+Z: undo. Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z: redo. Ctrl/Cmd+A: select all. Escape: clear selection. Arrow keys: move inspected pixel.
